text:
Records Management System Modernization
SUMMARY OFFUNDS	FY 2025	FY 2026
	Actual	Estimate

FOOTNOTES

1/ The amount appropriated for records management system modernization is exempt from the provisions of section 35- 190, Arizona Revised Statutes, relating to lapsing of appropriations, until June 30, 2026. (FY 2026 General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as a Lump Sum by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$6,452,800 and 58.2 FTE Positions from the Liquor Licenses Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. Adjustments are as follows:

Remove One-Time Operations Funding

The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(100,000) from the Liquor Licenses Fund in FY 2027 to remove one-time funding for increased agency operations funding.

Records Management System Modernization

The Baseline includes no funding in FY 2027 for records management system modernization. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026. An FY 2026 General Appropriations Act footnote stipulates that the \$2,900,000 FY 2025 supplemental appropriation for this line item is non-lapsing through June 30, 2026.

Anti-Racketeering Revolving Fund (LLA2131/A.R.S. § 13-2314.01) Non-Appropriated

Source of Revenue: Forfeitures of property and assets to satisfy judgments pursuant to state anti-racketeering statutes. Purpose of Fund: To investigate and prosecute any offense defined as racketeering pursuant to Arizona statutes. Funds Expended 4,900 0 Year-End Fund Balance 0 0

Audit Surcharge Fund (LLA3010/A.R.S. § 4-209) Non-Appropriated
